'''Edward Stoddard There is good in him Yeah Right''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Edward Stoddard]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-21061">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21061 There is good in him   Yeah Right], DeckTech (edward "pimpwizard69" stoddard, 31 January 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/21061/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/21061/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016192342/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21061/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
